title: Remote dual-rail power budget
description: A 48V supply feeds a remote board over a 3 ohm cable. On the remote board, derive a 12V rail and a 5V rail with series dropper resistors, and also supply a 50mA auxiliary load. Required exactly: 'V1 vin 0 DC 48', 'Rsense vin top 0.5', 'Rwire top remote 3', 'Rl12 v12 0 60', 'Rl5 v5 0 50', 'Iaux remote 0 DC 50m'. Constraints: V(v12) = 12V +/-2%, V(v5) = 5V +/-2%, and total supply current at most 0.4A (drop across Rsense at most 0.2V). Add your dropper resistors from 'remote' to 'v12' and from 'remote' to 'v5'. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
